current.text: Experts rank him a top-4 pick in 9-cat. Yahoo's rank of 4 is called reasonable.
Tier 1 point guard. In category leagues it is worth considering him over Luka Doncic because of his efficiency edge.
Projected at about 33 percent usage and 33 minutes per game.
Josh would not pay more than 60 USD for him in an auction.
He went for 68 USD in an expert auction mock draft.
Reports say he will do more off-ball work. He did some of that for Team Canada.
The off-ball work could mean fewer assists, fewer shots or more threes, or no change at all. It may be tied to OKC giving more minutes to Ajay Mitchell and Jared McCain. Worth watching early.
With our March 28 end date, OKC plays 4, 3 and 4 games in fantasy playoff weeks 19 to 21. That is a better playoff schedule than Doncic's.
OKC traded away Lu Dort, Isaiah Joe and Aaron Wiggins and replaced them with rookies and unproven young players.
OKC may lean more on offense through him, Ajay Mitchell and Jalen Williams. The team is expected to push its core players to shoot more threes.
OKC is projected to win about 62 games and be a top-two seed in the West.

durable.text: Back-to-back MVP. He has improved every year, including a big jump as a playmaker last season.
Takes few threes. He scores with elite contested mid-range jumpers, which OKC counts as efficient shots for him.
He is an outlier in FG% and FT% on high volume. His free throw impact is among the best in the league.
Points and steals are also league outliers.
His weakest categories are rebounds, blocks and threes. None of them is weak enough to hurt a build.
Injuries were a concern earlier in his career, but he has stayed healthy the last couple of seasons.

note: He is a top-4 pick for 9-cat. He lifts both FG% and FT% on big volume and adds outlier points and steals, so he fits every build. Market prices are 58 to 64 USD in value and 67 to 73 USD in average cost, and our league paid 81 USD for him last season. The expert cap is 60 USD, so a bid in the high 60s is about the limit. Early in the season, check whether the reported off-ball role cuts his assists and shots or adds threes. Also check that the Yahoo Q (Rest) tag is just preseason rest.
